## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, the previous behavior, and the result. Link the issue, design,
HIS increment or product ruling when relevant.

## Validation

Record the checks executed and their results. Explain any skipped checks and
environment limits; distinguish unit/browser evidence from clinical or hardware
validation.

## Data and rollout

Describe migrations, transactional boundaries, permission/profile changes, feature
defaults, offline behavior and recovery steps when affected. Identify unresolved
rulings or dependency advisories; omit this section for changes that affect none.
